**Research methods:**
- Google Maps/Reviews - filter by rating and read recent hail damage reviews
- Yelp - look for roofers specializing in hail damage
- Better Business Bureau (BBB) - check ratings and complaint history
- Nextdoor or local Facebook groups - ask neighbors for recommendations
- Your insurance company - they often have preferred contractors

**What to look for:**
- Licensed and insured in Colorado
- Experience with hail damage specifically
- Multiple quotes (get 3+)
- References from recent hail jobs
- Clear warranty terms
- Transparent pricing

**Red flags:**
- Pressure to decide quickly
- Unwillingness to work with insurance
- No physical address or license info

Since Denver gets hail regularly, there are many reputable options. Taking time to compare a few will likely serve you better than relying on a single recommendation.
